notes: Independent read-only inspection used only pilot_source inventory, read, search and check_bindings. No delegation, shell, tests, other audits or conversations were used.

For each certificate, check_bindings recomputed 478 declaration spans with no span errors, matching receiver set/digest and archive digest, and returned the exact binding recorded above. Inspected host/certificate_spans.go:14-45 independently: original source is parsed; keys use file, qualified declaration symbol and AST kind; spans run from scanner.GetTokenPosOfNode(n,f,false) to n.End(); duplicate keys become ambiguous. These bindings establish attribution, not semantic truth.

The verdicts retain every supplied precondition and apply only after successful warm-up. Failed or partial warm-up is quarantined. The supervisor buffers child stdout and reuses the same serialized input/config/dependency snapshot for its fresh vanilla child; it does not reread those files between attempts.

These four conditional cache proofs do not establish purity, input ownership, completeness of virtual receivers throughout the structures loop, general lowering equivalence, arbitrary-byte serialization fidelity, or safety of parallel execution. Statement-array splicing, node construction, result mutation and file-information work remain separate whole-loop obligations. No runtime parallelism is assumed.
